rules: First matching row wins. `class` names the Reference-side member class; `under` requires an ancestor of that class; `mro_missing` admits an mro difference only when the Reference chain is the portal chain plus exactly those names; `scope` (constructions, scenes, or any by default) limits where a row applies and is checked for staleness. A behavior-note row is a deliberate, documented divergence. An open-bead row is a known bug: an open-bead row that matches nothing in its scope fails the diff, so a fixed bug forces its row out.

exclusions.reason: Glyphs are plain VMobject (Reference VMobjectFromSVGPath), and Tex rules are not Rectangle.
Native typesetting over bundled faces and fmd-math: glyph metrics and outlines differ from Pango/LaTeX by design. BN-05 keeps glyph order and count, and class/structure stays compared.
Glyph outlines inside text are BN-05 native typesetting.
The point-less Text/Tex root reports opacity and width 1 where the Reference reports 0.
Brace is a parametric path family, not a stretched \underbrace glyph render (BN-08 table). Its root is the drawn path, not a container of glyph children.
The Reference's brace glyph children do not exist in the parametric path family (BN-08).
DecimalNumber is native text through Scribe with a per-character glyph cache (BN-08, 'Why DecimalNumber is a cache').
Each digit is one glyph submobject, not a Text wrapping a glyph path, so the family is one level shallower (BN-08).

The Reference builds each Annulus circle with quadratic_bezier_points_for_arc(TAU), whose default is 8 components (35 points). FrankenManim applies BN-09's one arc-density rule, 16 components for a full circle (67 points). bbox stays compared.
Default stroke/fill colors differ: Annulus and VCube stroke, NumberPlane axis fill.
The portal's VGroup lacks Group in its MRO (Reference: VGroup(Group, VMobject)). Applies only when Group is the entire difference.
The Reference's scene.mobjects starts with the CameraFrame; the portal's does not.
